# awscc_iot_policy_principal_attachment (Resource)

Resource Type definition for AWS::IoT::PolicyPrincipalAttachment



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `policy_name` (String) The name of the AWS IoT policy
- `principal` (String) The principal, which can be a certificate ARN (as returned from the CreateCertificate operation) or an Amazon Cognito ID

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_iot_policy_principal_attachment.example
  identity = {
    policy_name = "policy_name"
    principal   = "principal"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `policy_name` (String) The name of the AWS IoT policy
- `principal` (String) The principal, which can be a certificate ARN (as returned from the CreateCertificate operation) or an Amazon Cognito ID

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_iot_policy_principal_attachment.example
  id = "policy_name|principal"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import awscc_iot_policy_principal_attachment.example "policy_name|principal"
```
